uncited: Visibility Splatting (Pass 1):** Perform splatting with an additional depth comparison.
Attribute Accumulation (Pass 2):** Perform splatting with two additional depth comparisons in the fragment shader: one with the depth of the previous layer and one with the depth of opaque objects.
Normalization and Deferred Shading (Pass 3):** Normalize the accumulated attributes and perform deferred shading.

**Last Layer Modulation:** To mitigate artifacts when the viewpoint contains more than $n$ visible transparent layers, transparency coefficients are used to modulate the splatting weights in the last layer $n$.
